detail.longDescription: Hello # InfoSec ! I just released the open-source core of IJRAP Security (GNU AGPLv3), an offline-first forensic evidence sealer written purely in the # Python standard library (zero dependencies). It binds audio, video, photos & text with UTC timestamps, GPS & hybrid hashing (SHA-256 + SHA-3-256) to protect # Journalism & # HumanRights field data. Code & docs: https:// github.com/ijrapmedia/ijrap-se curity-public Security reviews and feedback are very welcome! # Forensics # OSINT # OpenSource
